Use case: stylized-concept. Paint ONE standalone high-detail nautical fantasy ship portrait for a game dossier, an opaque vertical 5:6 image, ideally 1280x1536.
Input image is an identity/design reference atlas only. Select ONLY the ship in the BOTTOM ROW, THIRD COLUMN: the low broad cargo barge with continuous red canvas awnings, stacked wooden crates and barrels, heavy dark timber hull, rope fenders, compact stern cabin and a small red flag. Do not reproduce the atlas or other ships.
Subject: Salt Mountain, a heavy ocean-going cargo barge. Preserve this vessel's low horizontal silhouette, red cargo canopies, working wooden construction and lack of tall masts. Redraw it as a beautifully detailed realistic painterly game illustration floating at a salt-trading harbor in golden late afternoon. Calm teal water, salt warehouses and old stone quays softly behind it, warm lantern highlights, atmospheric but readable.
Composition: three-quarter view showing side and bow, whole ship visible, centrally placed and occupying about 75% of image width. All extremities and flag safely inside the image with at least 8% margin. Show water foreground and sky/harbor above so the vessel fills a portrait scene naturally. Rich warm wood and red fabric, subtle cool sea contrast, crisp ship details, softer background. Consistent western medieval age-of-sail fantasy art, no modern elements.
No text, no labels, no frame, no parchment, no UI, no collage, no transparency, no solid black or blue background, no extra foreground ships.

No text, labels, typography, picture frame, parchment, UI, collage, transparency, flat black background, blue screen, modern vessels or extra foreground ships.

Show the COMPLETE ship, every mast tip, flag, stern and bowsprit, all inside central 80% of width and central 84% of height with generous safety margins for an ornamental portrait frame.
